For example, numbers 47, 744, 4 are lucky and 5, 17, 467 are not.Let next(x) be the minimum lucky number which is larger than or equals x. source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The single line contains two integers l and r (1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ 109) — the left and right interval limits.
